question: What is the performance reported for the best models in the VLSP 2018 and VLSP 2019 challenges?
title: VAIS ASR: Building a conversational speech recognition system using language model combination
answer_short: 4.85% WER for VLSP 2018 and 15.09% WER for VLSP 2019
answer_rationale: The best performance for VLSP 2018 is 4.85% WER and for VLSP 2019 is 15.09% WER, as explicitly stated in block 1 and confirmed in block 9, which details the system combination weights yielding these results.
